title: Drunk drivers to soon face automatic license revocation — LTO
summary: The Land Transportation Office (LTO) on Tuesday said it would make license revocation an automatic penalty for motorists who exceed legal alcohol limits starting Nov. 15 as part of efforts to curb…

blocks.text: The Land Transportation Office (LTO) on Tuesday said it would make license revocation an automatic penalty for motorists who exceed legal alcohol limits starting Nov. 15 as part of efforts to curb drunk driving and prevent road accidents.
